name: CROC_ST_WAIT_START
meaning: anim 4 at the path start; walks when the Wolf is in ACTIVATIONBOX and in front (+-700)

name: CROC_ST_WAIT_END
meaning: anim 4 at the path end; retreats when the Wolf leaves the box or gets behind

name: CROC_ST_BACKWARD
meaning: follows the path back toward the start

name: CROC_ST_BITE
meaning: Wolf MSG_KILL arg 10 (KILL_CROCODILE), anim 8, then state 0

name: CROC_ST_TURN
meaning: turn-around anim (1 walk / 0 run), then stateAfterTurn and facing += 0x800

name: CROC_ST_DEAD
meaning: anim 2; the corpse bounces a Wolf/FloatingBox that drops on it (MSG_BOUNCE 0x4B); survives Reset

name: CROC_ST_SPIN_TO_START
meaning: anim 0xb, per-frame spin back to startFacing, then state 0
